name: qa-crawler
description: Autonomous QA coverage crawler: maps the whole app and inspects every node (the inverted maze), with a deterministic engine + ledger + pattern library exposed over MCP, plus a skill and orchestrator/worker subagents.

playwright.description: Playwright MCP with auto browser selection: attaches to Neko over CDP when one is reachable (local 9223 or $QA_NEKO_CDP — the server case), else launches its own Chromium, headed if a display exists (the laptop case). $QA_BROWSER=launch forces local. Remove this block to use the qa-crawler engine alone.
